join.note: HyperLEDA's numerical morphological type t and its total B magnitude corrected for Galactic extinction, inclination and redshift (btc), each joined by PGC number; empty where HyperLEDA has none. Queried 2026-09-29.

groupDistance.basis: A galaxy's own distance modulus carries a median uncertainty of 0.5 mag in table 2 (e_DM), about 26% in distance, so a group drawn at its members' own distances is smeared along the line of sight into a spike several times longer than it is wide. Tully et al. (2023) average each group's members into one group distance (table 3, DMzp). Members sit at that distance, spread in depth as widely as the group spreads across the sky: that it is as deep as it is wide is an assumption (a group with no preferred axis), not a measurement of any member's depth.

groups.note: Columns 7 and 8: the group's dominant galaxy (table 2, 1PGC) and the group's distance modulus on the calibrated scale (table 3, DMzp), joined by PGC; column 8 is empty for the 7 galaxies whose group table 3 does not list.

sample: The tracked file keeps the 27,277 of CF4's 55,877 galaxies whose distance modulus puts them between 3 and 200 Mpc (27.386 to 36.505 mag), in PGC order. Nearer, the Local Group catalogue (src/objects/local-group) draws each galaxy; farther, only the SDSS fundamental-plane sample reaches, over part of the northern sky.
meaning: Every galaxy of Cosmicflows-4 (Tully et al. 2023) between 3 and 200 Mpc, each at its measured distance (the distance modulus of all methodologies), or, for a group of two or more, at the group's averaged distance, coloured by its HyperLEDA morphological type.

endsNm.basis: The Sc template's optical spectrum ends at 766 nm. Cutting the other four templates at 766 nm leaves each colour the same to the sRGB step (checked 2026-09-29), since the eye's response there is under 0.1% of its peak.

missing.label: no type in HyperLEDA
missing.basis: The D65 white point: a galaxy with no measured type is drawn without a colour.

toneBy.basis: Presentation of a measured quantity: each galaxy's absolute B magnitude (btc minus its CF4 distance modulus) darkens its colour, from full at M_B -21.5 to 30% at -17.5, linear in magnitude. The bounds are about the 5th and 95th percentiles of the field (-21.4 and -17.7), so the tones span the galaxies drawn.

sizeBy.basis: Presentation of a measured quantity: three dot sizes by absolute B magnitude, ranked among the galaxies at about the same distance (16 shells of equal count), so the survey reaching only luminous galaxies far away does not make the far dots the large ones. The brightest quarter of each shell draws 0.9 px, the middle half 0.65 px and the faintest quarter 0.5 px. The radii keep the bank's total light (each dot's luminance times its area) within 2% of its one 0.75 px size before, measured on the baked stack, so the sizes move light between galaxies without adding any.

classBasis: Class bounds are the midpoints between the de Vaucouleurs numerical types the templates stand for (E -5, S0 -2, Sa 1, Sb 3, Sc 5); types later than Sc take the Sc template, the latest in the atlas.
